scope: Vulkan engine interactions plus separate CPU fixtures; no native viewport FPS claim
historical_profile_isolation: These recorded benchmarks used factory startup, backend assertions and BLENDER_USER_RESOURCES, but did not verify Blender's resolved CONFIG path. Profile isolation was therefore not proven. Later GUI profile seeding exposed fallback to real user preferences; a verified backup was restored. Launchers were subsequently hardened with explicit resource-directory overrides and a resolved CONFIG guard, without changing the measured add-on source or these timings.
status_meaning: Benchmark correctness, environment, stable source and protocol checks passed; PASS does not mean every timing improved.

performance_assessment.plain: All three 2048 warmed wall medians improved: roughness 79.37 to 47.84 ms, opacity 283.33 to 160.22 ms, republish 303.68 to 128.26 ms. Smaller opacity workloads did not improve.
performance_assessment.masked: Mixed results, with unresolved regressions. At 2048 mask wall median rose 178.55 to 239.83 ms (final p95 681.19 ms), republish 234.89 to 271.45 ms. No general masked-workload speedup is established.
performance_assessment.attribution: Paired same-process probes support targeted constant-channel gains and the fusion size cap. They do not override the final normalized sweep results.

data.scope: CPU-only reused contiguous NumPy float32 buffer; no GPU context
data.order: rotate methods each iteration and reverse odd iterations

decisions.fusion: Enabled only up to 1024 pixels. Paired 2048 timings did not justify enabling it despite exact pass reductions.
decisions.constants: Enabled for proved spatially constant data channels. Contiguous CPU fills and lazy image upload address the intermediate roughness regression.
decisions.pixels: All final output hashes equal the respective fresh baseline at every measured size and fixture.

superseded_note: These intermediate sweeps used eager constant upload/clear and uncapped fusion. Their timing regressions triggered the paired probes and source changes; they are not final performance evidence.
